mapper.select: SELECT verification_id, email, code_hash, failed_attempts, created_at, expires_at, verified_at, verification_token_hash, token_expires_at, consumed_at FROM email_verification WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY verification_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT verification_id, email, code_hash, failed_attempts, created_at, expires_at, verified_at, verification_token_hash, token_expires_at, consumed_at FROM email_verification WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification SET verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} AND verified_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE email_verification SET failed_attempts = failed_attempts + 1 WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} AND failed_attempts < 5 AND verified_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE email_verification SET verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, verification_token_hash = #{tokenHash}, token_expires_at = #{tokenExpiresAt} WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} AND verified_at IS NULL AND failed_attempts < 5 AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE email_verification SET consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE email = #{email} AND verification_token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND token_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND consumed_at IS NULL
